# sigma_shared_template_acceptance (Resource)

Acceptance of a workbook template shared with this org. Create runs `POST /v2/shared_templates/accept`; destroy runs `DELETE /v2/shared_templates/{shareId}`. Discover pending shares via the `data.sigma_shared_templates` data source.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `share_id` (String) Identifier of the pending share to accept.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_shared_template_acceptance.example '<share_id>'
```
